name: custom-field-def
description: One operator-defined customer property (backlog:434cc39a, backlog:c6c56dad): a space-wide field with a key, an Italian label and a type (testo, numero, data, si-no, scelta, punteggio). Definitions are space-wide: every scheda, filter and list column reads the same set. The framework never invents one: a definition is a human decision, and a value without a definition is refused. Punteggio is a 0-100 score the AI can fill from a question.
